validated_objective: Release QIF v0.7.0 with an executable Empirical Calibration Pilot Contract that can begin governed data collection without claiming calibration before observed evidence exists
scope: calibration-report pilot protocol, domain plan, prospective enrollment, outcome observation, and pilot assessment records
deterministic verifier checks, example-only pending package, retained negative fixtures, docs, portable package, and release
constraints: do not fabricate real outcomes, integrate external systems, collect personal data, or grant operational authority
counts, domain coverage, confidence, and calibration metrics remain evidence rather than quality
expected_outcomes: planned, observing, missing, excluded, and completed evidence states remain distinct and traceable
a pilot cannot be empirically ready without verified observed outcomes and required domain coverage
